metadata.name: solana
metadata.description: zKube game program for Solana and MagicBlock

accounts.name: newest_daily

Needed only when something is left to move.

accounts.name: arena_daily

accounts.name: cadence_funding
docs: finalized boards no longer need.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Governance authority chosen by the upgrade authority; pays both rents.

accounts.name: upgrade_authority
docs: Only the program's upgrade authority may bootstrap its protocol.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Original signer that funded this account and receives its rent back.

fields.name: finish_reason
docs: Explicit caller-selected terminal resolution. Automatic completion or
exhaustion keeps this empty.

fields.name: deadline_at
docs: Ranked actions and VRF callbacks are rejected at this immutable cutoff.

fields.name: daily_score
docs: Arena leaderboard score: pressure-scaled triangular action points.

fields.name: objective_total
docs: Uncapped shared-kind increments attributable only to the Daily theme.

fields.name: combo_counter
docs: Saturating count of player moves that cleared at least two lines.

fields.name: streak
docs: Consecutive player moves that each clear at least one line.

fields.name: charges_earned
docs: Guardian trigger events produced across the run, before inventory caps.

fields.name: reroll_charges
docs: Held preview replacements; every run starts with one.

fields.name: vrf_request_counter
docs: VRF requests issued for this run so far; the next request takes this number.

fields.name: replay_hash
docs: Domain-separated rolling commitment over rules, VRF rows, and actions.

types.name: ArenaBoard
docs: One board of a Daily. While the Daily runs, the account is this header
followed by the retained rows, best first; only consuming a run writes
them. Finalization fills the payout fields, keeps the paying rows and
appends one claim bit per row. A board is sealed exactly when its Daily is
finalized, so it carries no clock of its own.

fields.name: predecessor_day
docs: The Daily prepared before this one. Its entries' prize share and its
rollover reach this Daily only from that day, when it finalizes.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Original signer that funded this account and receives its rent back.

types.name: BestRun
docs: A wallet's best result on one board of one Daily. The wallet is the
daily player account's own `player`, so it is not repeated here.

fields.name: best_prize_rank
docs: Zero means no payout-bearing Daily rank.

fields.name: available_prize_lamports
docs: Prize deposits not yet routed to a Daily by spent Kredits.

fields.name: active_run_id
docs: Zero when the Arcade slot is idle.

fields.name: active_run_daily
docs: Base-layer reservation remains authoritative while the run PDA is
delegated to an ephemeral rollup.

fields.name: orphan_run_id
docs: A deterministically expired run remains reserved until its delayed ER
copy is committed and the orphan account is closed.

fields.name: campaign_stars
docs: Two bits per level for exactly ten zones of ten levels. Campaign stars
are the sole progression source; all unlocks and badges are derived.

fields.name: featured_emblem
docs: Zero selects the strongest currently unlocked emblem automatically.

fields.name: score_record
docs: The two Daily boards keep separate records. They rank the same runs by
different metrics, so one aggregate cannot say whether a player wins by
total performance or by playing the day's theme — which is the whole
reason the pot splits in two.

fields.name: kredit_balance
docs: One-way prepaid entries owned by this wallet identity.

fields.name: ladder_points
docs: Monotonic, non-monetary points accumulated by qualification and claims.

fields.name: highest_ladder_tier
docs: Highest ladder tier ever reached; it never decreases, even through a reset.

fields.name: featured_frame_tier
docs: Ladder border the player has chosen to wear. Any tier they have ever
reached stays available: a rank is earned once, and a border the player
liked should not be taken back by a later reset.

fields.name: best_daily_score
docs: Best `daily_score` ever recorded on a scored arcade run. A board keeps
only payout-bearing rows and its accounts are recycled, so a personal
best has nowhere else to survive.

fields.name: last_entry_day_id
docs: Day identifier of the most recent paid entry, which the streak below
is measured against.

fields.name: entry_streak_days
docs: Consecutive days carrying at least one paid entry.

fields.name: entry_lamports
docs: The prize share of the entries of the Daily before this one.

fields.name: next_pot_lamports
docs: The prize share of this Daily's own entries. It waits here, outside
this Daily's pot, and moves to the next Daily at finalization.

types.name: ProtocolConfig
docs: Run identifiers are per-player and begin at one on every fresh deployment.

fields.name: replay_domain
docs: Chain/deployment-specific replay domain used by canonical replay v2.

fields.name: suspended_until_day
docs: Days below this absolute identifier are suspended; zero disables it.

fields.name: last_prepared_day
docs: Highest prepared Daily; the next prepared Daily names it as predecessor.

fields.name: last_daily_id
docs: Last finalized Daily committed by the permanent result root.

types.name: RunScored
docs: Logged when a scored run is consumed. A finalized board keeps only its
paying rows and daily player accounts close, so this is the public record
of every result, including the ranks below the paying rows. It grants
nothing: boards and claims never read it.
